name: D634-03 (Hubble)
blurb: D634-03, an isolated low-surface-brightness galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: d63403-hubble
story: A faint, isolated galaxy that its observers called the most unusual low-surface-brightness object on its survey list. It sits in a filament of nearby galaxies and moves out of step with the smooth expansion of space.

claims.text: D634-03 was observed with ACS/WFC in program 9771 at RA 09 08 53.50, Dec +14 34 55.00, matching this pointing (RA 137.2229, Dec 14.5819)
D634-03 is a galaxy imaged in the HST Cycle 12 snapshot program 9771
D634-03 is the most unusual low-surface-brightness object on the Taylor et al. (1996) list
D634-03 is isolated and has a high peculiar velocity (moves out of step with the Hubble flow)
D634-03 is situated in a filament with other nearby galaxies
